name: Way of the Open Hand
summary: Masters of unarmed combat who topple, push and heal.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.short: Flurry hits can knock prone, push 15 ft. or stop reactions.
features.summary: When you hit with a Flurry of Blows attack, you can impose one effect: the target makes a DEX save or is knocked prone, makes a STR save or is pushed 15 ft., or can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.short: Action: heal three times your monk level.
features.summary: As an action, you regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. Once per long rest.

features.name: Tranquility
features.short: After a long rest, you're under a Sanctuary effect.
features.summary: At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a Sanctuary spell until the start of your next long rest (DC 8 + WIS + PB). It ends if you attack or cast a spell that affects an enemy.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.short: Set lethal vibrations; trigger them to drop a foe to 0 HP.
features.summary: When you hit with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki to start vibrations that last a number of days equal to your monk level. As an action you end them: the target makes a CON save, dropping to 0 hit points on a failure or taking 10d10 necrotic on a success.
